The '''Til system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tililix]] and the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Til]]. The system was wiped barren when Til went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] and destroyed Tililix in its wake.
